organization.name: Grokability, Inc.
organization.notes: Grokability, Inc. makes Snipe-IT. Official About says Alison Gianotto created the project in 2013; exact company incorporation year is unverified. Reviewed company and project sources do not resolve outside equity funding or investors; funding remains unknown.

pricingTiers.name: Self-hosted
pricingTiers.notes: Free software; own infrastructure. Hosted subscriptions and professional support are separate.
No unique vendor popular designation found.

pricingTiers.name: Small Business Hosting
pricingTiers.notes: Managed Small Business Hosting: unlimited assets/users. Monthly$99.99 or total annual$999.99 explicitly published; hosting differences are services, not a separate software edition.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise Support
pricingTiers.notes: Enterprise Support FAQ explicitly gives$4, 999.99 USD per year. Self-hosted support service, not proprietary software features or hosting.

moats.claim: Accumulated custody records and integration workflows create practical migration costs; the open distribution limits proprietary feature lock-in.

productReasons.claim: Checkout acceptance, digital signatures and assignment history establish custody of physical equipment.
Barcode/QR scanning, custom fields and asset auditing support inventory reconciliation.
License expiry alerts, accessory/consumable records and REST integrations extend asset tracking beyond laptop lists.

sponsorship.notes: Reviewed project/company sources; no separate corporate sponsor verified. Verified business steward supplied as fallback.

requirements.notes: JSON, Open SSL, PDO, Mbstring, Tokenizer, c URL, My SQLi, ZIP, Fileinfo, BCMath, XML, Sodium and Exif documented.
Use supported My SQL/Maria DB backend.
Current config supports only My SQL/Maria DB, not every Laravel SQLdriver.
Official Dockerimage bundles application runtime/webserver dependencies.

requirements.condition: Email alerts, password resets and acceptance workflows
requirements.notes: Log mail driver possible without delivery; email-dependent workflows then unavailable.

requirements.component: Redis, Memcached, APC or database sessions/cache
requirements.notes: File defaults and syncqueue do not require external Redis or worker.

requirements.condition: External upload storage instead of local disk
requirements.notes: Public/private S 3 settings optional; AWSSES is also an optional alternative to SMTP.

resources.os: Linux, Windows or mac OS webserver; Docker-capable host
resources.notes: No universal production CPU/RAM/disk minimum verified; inventory and attachment volume drive sizing.

selfHosting.notes: Native PHP/webserver/Composer or official snipe/snipe-it Docker route. SQL restricted to My SQL/Maria DB. Default file sessions/cache and synchronous queue need no separate Redis/queue service. Retain database, uploads and APP_KEY for recovery.

options.name: Linux install.sh installer
options.notes: Download and chmod script, then run ./install.sh on a fresh Cent OS/RHEL or Debian/Ubuntu system with no other sites. Preparation required; not a provider deployment button.

oneClickInstall.notes: Official Downloading guide documents install.sh automation. Download/chmod preparation required, then installer command automates a fresh Linux system. This is one-command installation, not true one-click. Unverified Digital Ocean route excluded.
